title: Pope Leo XIV to be discharged from hospital after successful lung cancer surgery today
summary_full: Pope Leo XIV is set to leave the hospital after a successful lung cancer surgery, demonstrating commendable recovery progress. He engaged positively with his senior aides, expressing heartfelt gratitude towards the medical team for their dedicated care. As doctors await crucial test results to plan further treatment, the pontiff's upcoming trip to Latin America from November 6 to 17 highlights his determination to fulfill his commitments.
